prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1038; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a sedan and an SUV. Driver 1 was operating the sedan southbound and stated the traffic signal was green for their direction. Driver 2 was operating the SUV eastbound and stated they had entered the intersection on a yellow light. The point of impact was the driver side of the sedan and the front passenger side of the SUV, consistent with a side-impact collision. Airbags deployed in the SUV. A passenger in the SUV was present and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and stated they did not wish to be transported by ambulance, though they were evaluated on scene by medical personnel. Both vehicles sustained disabling damage and were towed from the scene. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Citation issued to Driver 2 for failure to yield. Scene diagram and witness statements are attached to the report.
